asr.full_text: Shiraj Yes? Noyan? Noyan tara? Do you know Noyan? Who are you? I'm Yadi Then who are you to Noyan? I'm your husband See, I'm married I can't tell him about this on my father's face So to get job I travelled to different countries To save one thing I cannot say it in front of my father, that I am married I had given up my country for work I was just a regular family boy When I met a girl with him I didn't ask him, Why do you have I married you We can't say that? I never forgot you Today also, I don't I know that he can never forget me. That's why, let me tell my friend that we died here. I was helpless. That's why I'm begging you. How are you? Look Nadhi. Few people are so lucky that they can marry their favorite. Even after marriage If a woman is lucky enough to have a perfect husband... but a man who is happy with what he has can be love at the same time.. ...that's the same! You'll love Narayan, right? Here we go. I must keep my Naim in good hands! Let us go! Shiraj! Shiraj! I tried many times. I really tried... But my words were not heard. I... Do you think you would talk to yourself!? Hiro... You had gone from the station? Listen... He died for me. I've fallen for him... But you... Listen to a single word I have to say. I'm sorry... I'll be a widow someday. You came asking to know! Listen… Our brother is dead! Even though you asked me to stop But none of your words was worth one word You're only to blame! How can you make sense out of your mistakes? And stop even after seeing it? That night… I was waiting for you to tell you everything And you understood That I wanted you to get a divorce She just came to give divorce.. ..and if you think you can do it.. You have brought this issue to me. I only wanted to talk to you, and had to get divorce from you today. When I came and said I miss Shiraj.. ..you went to get divorce from him. You don't know what happened in the past. You're a cheater. It's impossible to stay here with you. You and I cannot live together in Nile. If I could see you live here, I wouldn't be here in the same condition today. Please don't cry! But everything won't happen. It's very special. I brought many people for you. Only for you... Nayan! Naadi! You've tried so hard to get you back but only for this. No Aadi, I'm not like you You please leave! You please turn back towards your mother. You want her there? I can't fear my dad, and I cannot even fear God. I love you. Sorry, bhai. I already have a Boyfriend. Let's get his number. Sorry brother. Listen, I've already got a boyfriend. Fit and final! Thank you for watching! If you have any question or request for suggestion, please ask in comments Like and share if u find it interesting Subscribe us for more video
